parsed.post: Discarding MATRIX_LR=0.1 (0.937 vs 0.910). Flagging a possible issue: TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' overlaps EVAL_SHARD=10, so recent gains may be validation leakage. Next I will train on shards 0-9 only and keep the other best settings.
parsed.description: Revert to best LR settings and exclude shard 10 from training to test whether previous gains were due to eval-shard overlap.
parsed.report_to_operator: Please verify if TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' includes evaluation shard 10; if so, current best results may be contaminated by training on the validation shard.
